# Phones and Tablets: References

Always prefer current vendor documentation. Menu paths and feature names change between releases and
makers; re-verify links and contents when updating this skill.

Last verified: 2026-10-31

## Vendor (authoritative)

### Apple

- Apple security releases (current iOS fixes, which older lines are still patched):
  https://support.apple.com/100100
- Apple Platform Security guide: https://support.apple.com/guide/security/welcome/web
- About Stolen Device Protection for iPhone (requirements, protected actions, Security Delay):
  https://support.apple.com/120340
- About Lockdown Mode (who it's for, what it restricts, supported versions): https://support.apple.com/105120
- Personal Safety User Guide (Safety Check, Emergency Reset, Manage Sharing & Access, checklists):
  https://support.apple.com/guide/personal-safety/welcome/web
- About Apple threat notifications and protecting against mercenary spyware:
  https://support.apple.com/102174
- Advanced Data Protection for iCloud (check regional availability): https://support.apple.com/108756
- About alternative app distribution (regions, Apple's limited support): https://support.apple.com/118110
- What to do before you sell, give away, or trade in your iPhone: https://support.apple.com/109511
- Shared iPad overview (requires device management, organization-issued Managed Apple Accounts,
  supervision, at least 32 GB; temporary sessions):
  https://support.apple.com/guide/deployment/shared-ipad-overview-dep9a34c2ba2/web
- Use Screen Time to manage your child's iPhone or iPad (Family Sharing or on the device):
  https://support.apple.com/108806
- Apple publishes product security support periods in its regulatory compliance statements (for example
  under the UK PSTI regime); find the statement for the model on Apple's regulatory pages.

### Google and Android

- Pixel update support periods by model (counted from first US Google Store availability):
  https://support.google.com/pixelphone/answer/4457705
- Android Security Bulletins (monthly patch levels): https://source.android.com/docs/security/bulletin
- Protect your personal data against theft (Theft Detection Lock, Offline Device Lock, Remote Lock,
  Identity Check, trusted places): https://support.google.com/android/answer/15146908
- Advanced Protection for Android (what it turns on, how to enable, caveats):
  https://support.google.com/android/answer/16339980
- Google Play Protect: https://support.google.com/googleplay/answer/2812853
- Android developer verification (sideloading changes, regions, timeline):
  https://developer.android.com/developer-verification
- Google Account Security Checkup: https://myaccount.google.com/security-checkup
- Google Advanced Protection Program (account level): https://landing.google.com/advancedprotection/
- Family Link: https://families.google/familylink/
- Pixel Tablet software updates (support dates for the tablet, separate from the phone page):
  https://support.google.com/googlepixeltablet/answer/13399216
- Delete, switch, or add users on your Pixel Tablet: https://support.google.com/googlepixeltablet/answer/13591529
- Use or delete guests on a Pixel Tablet: https://support.google.com/googlepixeltablet/answer/13567147
- About Google Kids Space (requires a Family Link-managed child account; multiple children on tablets
  that support multiple users): https://support.google.com/kidsspace/answer/9990724

### Samsung

- Samsung Mobile Security, security updates and per-model update tiers:
  https://security.samsungmobile.com/workScope.smsb
- Use Auto Blocker to protect apps and data on your Galaxy phone:
  https://www.samsung.com/us/support/answer/ANS10003636
- Samsung Knox documentation: https://docs.samsungknox.com/
- How do I add additional user accounts to my Galaxy tablet? (users and restricted profiles; the menu
  is missing on some recent models): https://www.samsung.com/uk/support/mobile-devices/how-do-i-add-additional-user-accounts-to-my-galaxy-tablet/

### Cross-platform

- Apple and Google joint support for unwanted tracking alerts (Detecting Unwanted Location Trackers):
  https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2024/05/apple-and-google-deliver-support-for-unwanted-tracking-alerts-in-ios-and-android/

Generic vulnerability and incident sources (CISA KEV, NVD, CVE, CISA ransomware guidance, IC3) are listed in
the core documents.

## Government and regulators

- CISA, Mobile Communications Best Practice Guidance (December 2024; check for a newer version):
  https://www.cisa.gov/sites/default/files/2024-12/guidance-mobile-communications-best-practices.pdf
- FCC, rules to protect consumers from SIM swap and port-out fraud (Report and Order, Federal Register,
  December 2023; some provisions had later compliance dates):
  https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2023-12-08/pdf/2023-26338.pdf
- FCC consumer guide, cell phone fraud (SIM swapping, port-out fraud, eSIM advice):
  https://www.fcc.gov/sites/default/files/cell_phone_fraud.pdf (the FCC site blocks some automated
  fetches; if the link moves, search fcc.gov for "port-out fraud")
- FTC consumer advice on SIM swaps and account takeovers: https://consumer.ftc.gov/

## Survivor safety and stalkerware

- Coalition Against Stalkerware, guidance for survivors (detection, safe removal, safety planning,
  evidence): https://stopstalkerware.org/stalkerware-detection-removal-and-prevention/
- Coalition Against Stalkerware, resources and support organizations by country:
  https://stopstalkerware.org/resources/
- National Network to End Domestic Violence, Safety Net technology safety resources:
  https://www.techsafety.org/
- US National Domestic Violence Hotline (online chat and phone): https://www.thehotline.org/

## Third-party (not authoritative)

- Access Now Digital Security Helpline (free help for people at risk, including suspected spyware):
  https://www.accessnow.org/help/ . Specialist referral; not a vendor source.
- EFF, "Google's Advanced Protection Arrives on Android: Should You Use It?" (2025): trade-offs explained;
  check against Google's current page:
  https://www.eff.org/deeplinks/2025/06/googles-advanced-protection-arrives-android-should-you-use-it
- EFF Surveillance Self-Defense: https://ssd.eff.org/ . Plain-language guides; may lag product changes.
- News report that Pixel Tablet Android version updates were extended to June 2028 (January 2026):
  https://9to5google.com/2026/01/29/google-gives-pixel-tablet-another-two-years-of-android-os-updates/ ;
  confirm on Google's Pixel Tablet updates page.
- News reports that Stolen Device Protection is on by default from iOS 26.4 (for example
  https://9to5mac.com/2026/02/16/ios-26-4-will-activate-key-theft-prevention-feature-on-all-iphones/);
  confirm on the device.
